decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01, 02, HA-03, 04, HA-05A, HA-06A, HA-07A, HA-08B, HA-09B, HA-10B (received 24/06/2013)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the south eastern elevation shall be obscure glazed and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - Other than as specified, no additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the south eastern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Removal of condition 6 (Restriction on use as HMO) of planning permission 00560/12/P5 dated 17/07/2013 for 'Use as a single dwelling (C3) and the erection of a first floor side extension, a part single storey part two storey rear extension, two rear roof extensions and installation of three front roof lights, one rear roof light and two side rear roof lights to the dwelling'.
